images.title: Book cover makes an angle
images.purpose: Show that an opened book cover and the page form two arms meeting at a vertex.
images.composition: A side view of a book opened a little, shown as two lines from one hinge point.
images.exact_structure: One horizontal teal #0072B2 line (the book base) from the hinge point to the right, and one amber #E69F00 line of the same length (the cover) rising from the same hinge point at about 40 degrees. A reddish purple #CC79A7 dot at the hinge labelled vertex. Exactly 2 equal arms, 1 vertex.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a full book drawing with pages and text
images.takeaway: An angle has two arms that meet at a vertex.
images.description: A teal base arm and an amber cover arm of equal length meeting at a purple vertex dot.
images.context: Shown with the concept as its one key picture, next to the walkthrough video. PLACEHOLDER: specified, not generated yet.
images.teaching_notes: Ask the student to point at the two arms and the vertex.

image_decisions.why: The idea is a picture idea; one clean image carries it.
